extraction.Name: Katherine Biggins
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded July 16, 1919, by A. L. Biggins
extraction.Buyer: Katherine Biggins McGill and Roswell Foster Magill conveyed the land by deed to Arthur L. Biggins and W. M. Quinn for $20,000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612793 issued; Southeast quarter section 21, township 99, north of range 76; receipt for patent signed by allottee February 14, 1918; conveyance dated August 1, 1919; allottee also appears as Katherine Biggins McGill and Katherine Biggins Magill in document
